note: ALL news sources of Wartabiye TV in ONE list. Section "somalia" is the website's REGIONAL feed (homepage), which since 5 Nov 2026 is EAST AFRICA ONLY: Kenya, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Djibouti, Eritrea. Somalia-specific sources are switched off and refused by tools/east_africa.py, and Somalia-focused articles are dropped from every section. GitHub Actions reads every enabled source with a feed before each 08:00/18:00 update; sources marked searchOnly are checked by the news task with WebSearch.

sources.name: The Local Italy

permission.summary: Terms of use: 'You may not copy, modify, reproduce, republish ... any material from this site'; personal non-commercial use only. Headline and link are used only to discover the story; Wartabiye TV writes its own report from verified facts with attribution and a link. Nothing is copied or translated from the article. Many articles are for members only (paywall): never bypassed.

sources.name: DutchNews.nl

permission.summary: DutchNews terms: commercial websites must contact editor@dutchnews.nl before using or syndicating its content; unauthorised use is invoiced. Wartabiye TV is advertising-supported, so NO headlines, links or text are collected or published until the owner has written permission. The 5-minute monitor only checks that the feed is reachable and how recent it is.

sources.notes: Switched off until DutchNews gives written permission (owner's instruction, 8 Nov 2026). To switch on after permission: set enabled true, remove monitorOnly, and set permission.status to 'licensed' with the date and terms.
